notes.title: "spring leaves no flowers" (3rd in one night, hot springs series) release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33436033/439fa98834ed7e621103ffab956336cf4fc1f5f7.png[/img]

hello! i have released "spring leaves no flowers", the third game in the one night, hot springs series. i never intended to make more than one game but i just wanted to share more of haru's, erika's and manami's stories, so here we are...

while i currently have no plans to release the game on steam, the game is available for free on pc (itch.io) and android (google play.)

play as manami, a young woman with a boyfriend named tatsuya, and join her as she spends the weekend with her friends haru & erika. help manami come to an understanding about herself as she thinks about what friendship and romance mean to her.

pc: https://npckc.itch.io/spring-leaves-no-flowers
android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.npckc.manami
